scenes.narration: The mistake is deciding by default. Unchosen spending is what hardens.
scenes.caption: गलती है बिना सोचे तय होना। अनचाहा खर्च ही जड़ पकड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A row of automatic payment mandates printed on a bank statement, every line ticked by the bank and none marked by hand, dim desk light

scenes.narration: A raise is a chance to reset a ratio, not a reward.
scenes.caption: बढ़ी कमाई इनाम नहीं, अनुपात दोबारा तय करने का मौका है।
scenes.image_brief: A pie chart drawn in chalk on a slate showing a household budget split, one wedge being redrawn larger with the chalk, workshop light

scenes.narration: Move part of the next raise to savings the same day.
scenes.caption: अगली बढ़ोतरी का एक हिस्सा उसी दिन बचत में डालें।
scenes.image_brief: A standing instruction form on a bank counter, filled in with a transfer date and amount, a pen resting across the page, bright branch lighting

title: 💥 Imran's budget broke twice a year... what a monthly plan forgets #budgeting #annualbills
title_alts: Imran's yearly bills: how dividing them by twelve steadies a budget
Imran budgeted month by month... and borrowed for bills he knew about
description_hook: A monthly budget only counts monthly bills. The costs that arrive once a year are the ones that force borrowing.
setting: a household planning sheet and a calendar year

claims.claim: Suppose four yearly bills total sixty thousand
claims.basis: round illustrative total, stated as illustrative in the narration

claims.claim: Divided by twelve, that is five thousand a month
claims.basis: arithmetic on the illustrative sixty thousand annual total

scenes.narration: Some bills arrive once a year and break monthly budgets.
scenes.caption: कुछ बिल साल में एक बार आते हैं और महीने का बजट तोड़ देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A wall calendar with four scattered squares circled heavily in red, a thick bundle of bills resting on the shelf below it, plain daylight

scenes.narration: Insurance premiums, school fees, festival spending, a vehicle service. A monthly budget counts none of them.
scenes.caption: बीमा, स्कूल फ़ीस, त्योहार, गाड़ी की सर्विस। महीने का बजट इन्हें गिनता नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Four unopened envelopes spread on a table, one insurance notice, one school fee slip, one festival shopping list and one garage estimate, even indoor light

scenes.narration: What turns a yearly shock into a monthly line? One division.
scenes.caption: साल का झटका महीने की लाइन कैसे बने? एक भाग से।
scenes.image_brief: A budget sheet on a desk where a large annual figure at the top is being carried down into twelve equal ruled rows below, lamp light

scenes.narration: Yearly costs are real costs. They just arrive in lumps.
scenes.caption: सालाना खर्च भी असली खर्च हैं। वे सिर्फ़ इकट्ठे आते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A single heavy sack of grain dropped on a weighing platform, the needle of the dial swung hard to the right, warehouse light

scenes.narration: Divide each one by twelve, and hold that share aside monthly.
scenes.caption: हर खर्च को बारह से बांटें, और वह हिस्सा हर महीने अलग रखें।
scenes.image_brief: The same sack of grain emptied into twelve small cloth pouches lined up in a row on the same platform, warehouse light

scenes.narration: Suppose four yearly bills total sixty thousand, a round illustrative figure.
scenes.caption: मान लीजिए चार सालाना बिल कुल साठ हज़ार हैं, सिर्फ़ उदाहरण के लिए।
scenes.image_brief: Four bills clipped together under a paperweight on a table beside a handwritten card reading yearly total, clean daylight

scenes.narration: Divided by twelve, that is five thousand a month.
scenes.caption: बारह से बांटें तो यह महीने के पांच हज़ार बनते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Twelve small identical envelopes laid in a grid on a table, each holding a few banknotes and marked with the same amount, even daylight

scenes.narration: The bills stop being emergencies. Nothing gets borrowed.
scenes.caption: बिल आपातकाल नहीं रहते। कुछ उधार नहीं लेना पड़ता।
scenes.image_brief: An insurance premium notice lying on a table beside an already-filled envelope of cash, the calendar square for it ticked in pen, calm morning light

scenes.narration: This only works if the share stays untouched.
scenes.caption: यह तभी चलता है जब वह हिस्सा छुआ न जाए।
scenes.image_brief: One of the twelve envelopes torn open and empty on a table, its banknotes gone and a snack wrapper lying next to it, harsh light

scenes.narration: A separate account helps. Money in the spending account gets spent.
scenes.caption: अलग खाता मदद करता है। खर्च वाले खाते का पैसा खर्च हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two bank passbooks side by side on a desk, one closed with a rubber band around it and the other open with many entries, desk light

scenes.narration: A yearly bill is not an unexpected bill.
scenes.caption: सालाना बिल अचानक आया बिल नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: The same wall calendar with all four circled squares now also ticked in green, the bundle of bills below it gone, bright daylight

scenes.narration: List every bill that arrives less often than monthly, then divide by twelve.
scenes.caption: जो बिल हर महीने नहीं आते, उन्हें लिखें और बारह से बांटें।
scenes.image_brief: A ruled notepad on a table with a short handwritten list of four items and a division by twelve worked out in the margin, morning light

title: 🎈 Neha got a raise and saved nothing… stops lifestyle creep
title_alts: Raise without savings explained
How to protect new income from spending spikes
description_hook: A salary increase can trigger hidden spending. Learn to keep more of your raise for future goals.

characters.name: Neha
characters.description: late 20s, ponytail, smart casual, thoughtful eyes

scenes.narration: A 20% raise vanished within months, leaving zero savings.
scenes.caption: २०% वेतन वृद्धि महीनों में गायब, बचत शून्य।
scenes.image_brief: Salary slip showing 20% increase next to an empty savings jar, bright office lighting.

scenes.narration: Higher income often feels like permission to spend more.
scenes.caption: बढ़ी आय अक्सर खर्च बढ़ाने की इजाज़त जैसा लगती है।
scenes.image_brief: Person browsing online shopping sites on a laptop, colorful product images.

scenes.narration: Without a plan, lifestyle creep erodes net worth fast.
scenes.caption: बिना योजना के, जीवनशैली में वृद्धि जल्दी नेट वर्थ घटाती है।
scenes.image_brief: Graph line sharply descending after a spike labeled ‘Raise’.

scenes.narration: You’ll learn a three‑step guard to lock away extra earnings.
scenes.caption: आप सीखेंगे तीन‑कदम की रक्षा जो अतिरिक्त आय सुरक्षित रखे।
scenes.image_brief: Three‑step ladder graphic labeled ‘Guard’ leading to a safe.

scenes.narration: Step one: allocate a fixed percentage of the raise to savings first.
scenes.caption: पहला कदम: वेतन वृद्धि का एक निश्चित प्रतिशत पहले बचत में रखें।
scenes.image_brief: Pie chart with a new slice labeled ‘Raise Savings 30%’.

scenes.narration: Step two: automate that amount into a high‑interest account.
scenes.caption: दूसरा कदम: उस राशि को स्वचालित रूप से उच्च‑ब्याज खाते में भेजें।
scenes.image_brief: Mobile app screen confirming scheduled transfer to ‘Savings Vault’.

scenes.narration: Raise adds ₹10,000; 30% equals ₹3,000 saved each month.
scenes.caption: वेतन वृद्धि ₹10,000, 30% = ₹3,000 मासिक बचत।
scenes.image_brief: Calculator display showing 10000×0.30=3000, highlighted.

scenes.narration: Over a year, that builds ₹36,000 extra without extra effort.
scenes.caption: एक साल में, यह बिना अतिरिक्त प्रयास के ₹36,000 बनाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Bar chart rising to ₹36,000 labeled ‘Yearly Savings’.

scenes.narration: If the raise is irregular, use the average of the last six months.
scenes.caption: यदि वृद्धि अनियमित है, तो पिछले छह महीनों का औसत लें।
scenes.image_brief: Line chart with irregular spikes, moving average line overlaid.

scenes.narration: Mistake: increasing discretionary spend before saving the raise.
scenes.caption: गलती: बचत से पहले वैकल्पिक खर्च बढ़ाना।
scenes.image_brief: Credit card statement with highlighted ‘new gadgets’ expenses.

scenes.narration: Protected earnings grow wealth while lifestyle stays comfortable.
scenes.caption: सुरक्षित आय धन बढ़ाती है और जीवनशैली आरामदायक रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: Growing plant in a pot labeled ‘Wealth’, sunlight streaming.

scenes.narration: Now a raise truly boosts financial security, not just consumption.
scenes.caption: अब वेतन वृद्धि वित्तीय सुरक्षा को बढ़ाए, केवल ख़पत नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: Scale balancing ‘Raise’ on one side, ‘Security’ on the other, balanced.

scenes.narration: Set up an automatic transfer today and watch your savings rise.
scenes.caption: आज ही स्वचालित ट्रांसफ़र सेट करें और अपनी बचत बढ़ते देखें।
scenes.image_brief: Hand pressing ‘Confirm’ on a banking app, green success tick.

title: 💥 Imran’s budget broke twice a year… avoids missed annual bills
title_alts: Annual bill timing explained
Preventing budget gaps from yearly expenses
description_hook: Learn how to align monthly budgets with yearly expenses so you never miss a payment again.

characters.name: Imran
characters.description: early 30s, glasses, casual shirt, focused expression

scenes.narration: Missing one annual bill can wreck a tight budget.
scenes.caption: एक वार्षिक बिल चूकना कड़े बजट को बर्बाद कर सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Empty wallet on a desk beside a overdue notice, stark lighting.

scenes.narration: Many monthly plans ignore expenses that occur once a year.
scenes.caption: कई मासिक योजनाएँ वार्षिक खर्चों को अनदेखा करती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Calendar page showing all months highlighted except a single ‘Tax’ sticker in December.

scenes.narration: When the due date arrives, cash shortfalls force loans.
scenes.caption: जब देयता आती है, नकदी की कमी से ऋण लेना पड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: Person reaching for a credit card with a worried look, soft shadows.

scenes.narration: You’ll see a simple method to spread yearly costs across months.
scenes.caption: आप देखेंगे एक सरल तरीका जो सालाना खर्च को महीनों में बाँटे।
scenes.image_brief: Graphic of a dollar sign splitting into 12 equal parts, clean background.

scenes.narration: First, list every annual obligation and its amount.
scenes.caption: पहले, सभी वार्षिक दायित्व और राशि लिखें।
scenes.image_brief: Notebook page titled ‘Annual Expenses’ with bullet points like ‘Insurance ₹12,000’.

scenes.narration: Then divide each by twelve and add to your monthly budget.
scenes.caption: फिर प्रत्येक को बारह से विभाजित करके मासिक बजट में जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: Calculator screen showing 12000÷12=1000, result typed into a budgeting spreadsheet.

scenes.narration: Insurance costs ₹12,000 yearly; add ₹1,000 each month.
scenes.caption: बीमा ₹12,000 सालाना, इसलिए हर महीने ₹1,000 जोड़ें।
scenes.image_brief: Bar graph comparing original budget bar versus budget with added insurance slice.

scenes.narration: Property tax ₹6,000 yearly becomes an extra ₹500 monthly.
scenes.caption: संपत्ति कर ₹6,000 सालाना, यानी ₹500 अतिरिक्त मासिक।
scenes.image_brief: Pie chart showing 5% slice labeled ‘Property Tax’ added to monthly expenses.

scenes.narration: If an expense varies, use the average of the last three years.
scenes.caption: यदि खर्च बदलता है, तो पिछले तीन वर्षों का औसत लें।
scenes.image_brief: Line chart with three fluctuating data points, average line highlighted.

scenes.narration: Mistake: assuming every yearly bill is fixed and predictable.
scenes.caption: गलती: मान लेना हर वार्षिक बिल स्थिर है।
scenes.image_brief: Sticky note with “fixed” crossed out over a variable utility bill.

scenes.narration: With spread costs, cash flow stays smooth and debt‑free.
scenes.caption: बिखरे हुए खर्चों से नकदी प्रवाह सुगम और बिना ऋण के रहता है।
scenes.image_brief: Smooth river flowing past rocks labeled ‘Bills’, sunny sky.

scenes.narration: Now annual payments no longer surprise or stress you.
scenes.caption: अब वार्षिक भुगतान आश्चर्य या तनाव नहीं बनते।
scenes.image_brief: Person smiling, calendar pages turning calmly, warm light.

scenes.narration: Create a simple spreadsheet today and allocate monthly buffers.
scenes.caption: आज ही एक सरल स्प्रेडशीट बनाएं और मासिक बफ़र आवंटित करें।
scenes.image_brief: Laptop screen showing a pre‑made budgeting template, cursor hovering over ‘Add Buffer’ column.

title: 💧 Meera’s emergency fund covers six months… stops cash crises
title_alts: Emergency fund safety net explained
Why a six‑month cushion prevents panic withdrawals
description_hook: Discover why a six‑month emergency fund can protect you from unexpected expenses and how to build it efficiently.

characters.name: Meera
characters.description: mid‑20s, short hair, casual sweater, determined look

scenes.narration: Six months of expenses saved stops financial panic instantly.
scenes.caption: छह महीने के खर्च बचाने से वित्तीय घबराहट तुरंत रुकती है।
scenes.image_brief: Close‑up of a piggy bank overflowing with coins on a kitchen countertop, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: Unexpected bills can appear at any time, draining cash quickly.
scenes.caption: अचानक बिल कभी भी आ सकते हैं, जल्दी से नकदी ख़त्म कर देते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Stack of utility bills spilling onto a table, soft indoor lighting.

scenes.narration: Without a cushion, people often borrow at high rates.
scenes.caption: बफ़र के बिना, लोग अक्सर उच्च दरों पर उधार लेते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Hand holding a credit card with a high interest warning sign, dim background.

scenes.narration: By the end, you’ll know how to size and protect that fund.
scenes.caption: अंत तक, आप इस फंड को कैसे आकार दें और सुरक्षित रखें, जानेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: Simple infographic showing a bar labeled ‘Emergency Fund’ growing to a target height, clean white background.

scenes.narration: First, calculate monthly essential spending, then multiply by six.
scenes.caption: पहले, मासिक आवश्यक खर्च निकालें, फिर उसे छह से गुणा करें।
scenes.image_brief: Spreadsheet view highlighting a row titled ‘Essential Expenses’ with a total, calculator beside it.

scenes.narration: Next, automate a small transfer each payday into a separate account.
scenes.caption: फिर, प्रत्येक वेतन के बाद एक छोटा ट्रांसफ़र अलग खाते में स्वचालित करें।
scenes.image_brief: Mobile banking app screen showing a scheduled transfer to a ‘Rainy Day’ account, pastel colors.

scenes.narration: If essentials total ₹15,000, the target fund equals ₹90,000.
scenes.caption: यदि आवश्यक खर्च ₹15,000 है, तो लक्ष्य फंड ₹90,000 होगा।
scenes.image_brief: Calculator display showing 15000×6=90000, highlighted result.

scenes.narration: Saving ₹5,000 each month reaches the goal in eighteen months.
scenes.caption: हर महीने ₹5,000 बचाने से अठारह महीने में लक्ष्य पूरा होगा।
scenes.image_brief: Timeline graphic with monthly markers, a progress bar filling to 100% at month 18.

scenes.narration: If income fluctuates wildly, a fixed six‑month rule may mislead.
scenes.caption: यदि आय बहुत बदलती है, तो स्थिर छह‑महीने का नियम गुमराह कर सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: Graph line showing erratic income spikes, question mark overlay.

scenes.narration: Common mistake: mixing discretionary spending into the fund.
scenes.caption: आम गलती: वैकल्पिक खर्च को फंड में मिलाना।
scenes.image_brief: Piggy bank labeled ‘Emergency’ filled with luxury items like a watch and shoes.

scenes.narration: A full cushion turns surprises into manageable events, not crises.
scenes.caption: पूरा बफ़र आश्चर्यों को प्रबंधनीय बना देता है, न कि संकट।
scenes.image_brief: Sunrise over a calm city skyline, warm light indicating stability.

scenes.narration: Now cash emergencies no longer dictate life choices.
scenes.caption: अब नकदी आपातकाल जीवन के फैसलों को नहीं तय करता।
scenes.image_brief: Open hand releasing a balloon labeled ‘Freedom’, blue sky background.

scenes.narration: Start a separate savings account today and set a recurring transfer.
scenes.caption: आज ही अलग बचत खाता खोलें और नियमित ट्रांसफ़र सेट करें।
scenes.image_brief: Smartphone showing ‘Create New Account’ button, bright UI colors.

title: 🌀 Kavya paid the minimum due every month… avoids credit card balance growth
title_alts: Minimum payment trap explained
How to stop credit card debt from snowballing
description_hook: Paying only the minimum on credit cards can silently increase debt. Discover how to break the cycle.

scenes.narration: Paying only the minimum adds months to debt repayment.
scenes.caption: केवल न्यूनतम भुगतान करने से ऋण चुकाने में महीनों का बढ़ाव होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Credit card statement highlighting the ‘Minimum Due’ amount, dim lamp light.

scenes.narration: Interest compounds on the remaining balance each cycle.
scenes.caption: ब्याज प्रत्येक चक्र पर शेष बैलेंस पर चक्रवृद्धि होता है।
scenes.image_brief: Animated gears representing interest compounding over a balance figure.

scenes.narration: A small unpaid portion grows faster than the original loan.
scenes.caption: छोटा बकाया हिस्सा मूल ऋण से तेज़ बढ़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: Bar chart where unpaid portion line overtakes original loan line.

scenes.narration: You’ll learn a clear method to cut interest and pay faster.
scenes.caption: आप सीखेंगे एक स्पष्ट तरीका जिससे ब्याज घटे और तेज़ भुगतान हो।
scenes.image_brief: Roadmap graphic labeled ‘Fast Payoff Path’ with checkpoints.

scenes.narration: First, calculate total monthly interest on the current balance.
scenes.caption: पहले, वर्तमान बैलेंस पर कुल मासिक ब्याज निकालें।
scenes.image_brief: Calculator screen showing balance ₹50,000 × 2% = ₹1,000 interest.

scenes.narration: Second, add that interest to the minimum due and pay the sum.
scenes.caption: दूसरा, इस ब्याज को न्यूनतम भुगतान में जोड़ें और कुल राशि भुगतान करें।
scenes.image_brief: Invoice style visual with ‘Minimum ₹2,000 + Interest ₹1,000 = Pay ₹3,000’.

scenes.narration: Balance ₹50,000, minimum ₹2,000, interest ₹1,000; pay ₹3,000 total.
scenes.caption: बैलेंस ₹50,000, न्यूनतम ₹2,000, ब्याज ₹1,000; कुल ₹3,000 भुगतान।
scenes.image_brief: Spreadsheet row highlighting the calculation steps.

scenes.narration: Next month balance drops to ₹47,500, reducing interest automatically.
scenes.caption: अगले महीने बैलेंस ₹47,500, ब्याज स्वचालित रूप से घटता है।
scenes.image_brief: Bar decreasing from ₹50,000 to ₹47,500 with a down arrow.

scenes.narration: If cash flow is tight, prioritize high‑interest cards first.
scenes.caption: यदि नकदी प्रवाह तंग है, तो उच्च‑ब्याज कार्ड को प्राथमिकता दें।
scenes.image_brief: Stack of credit cards with red tags on the highest interest one.

scenes.narration: Mistake: assuming the minimum will keep the credit score safe.
scenes.caption: गलती: मान लेना न्यूनतम भुगतान से क्रेडिट स्कोर सुरक्षित रहेगा।
scenes.image_brief: Credit score gauge showing a dip despite minimum payments.

scenes.narration: Paying the interest plus minimum shrinks debt dramatically each cycle.
scenes.caption: ब्याज + न्यूनतम भुगतान से प्रत्येक चक्र में ऋण बहुत घटता है।
scenes.image_brief: Line graph steeply descending toward zero debt.

scenes.narration: Soon the balance disappears, freeing cash for other goals.
scenes.caption: जल्दी ही बैलेंस गायब, अन्य लक्ष्यों के लिए नकदी मुक्त।
scenes.image_brief: Open wallet with cash spilling out, bright sunrise background.

scenes.narration: Calculate today’s interest, add it to your payment, and start the fast track.
scenes.caption: आज का ब्याज निकालें, उसे भुगतान में जोड़ें, और तेज़ ट्रैक शुरू करें।
scenes.image_brief: Hand holding a calculator, pressing ‘Enter’ on a payment app screen.
